oracle-risk.name: Oracle AI risk management practice, September 2026

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Capacity and performance are monitored against availability commitments” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: capacity thresholds, utilization trends, demand forecasts, and capacity changes linked to service commitments
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Physical access is limited to authorized personnel” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: authorized entry lists, physical entry restrictions, visitor records, access reviews, and investigated entry exceptions
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Asset retirement prevents recovery of residual data and software” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: retired-asset inventory, approved sanitization methods, removal of residual data and software, completion records, and verification before release or reuse
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text.

repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text.

repairs.evidence_checks: approved ethical-conduct expectations, personnel acknowledgments, reporting channels, recorded violations, and timely investigation and corrective follow-up
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.evidence_checks: board and committee responsibilities, member independence and relevant expertise, oversight agendas and minutes, management challenge, and tracked follow-up decisions
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.evidence_checks: role-specific competence requirements, hiring and assessment records, periodic performance reviews, training needs, and remediation of identified skills gaps
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.evidence_checks: assigned control responsibilities, communicated performance expectations, consideration of incentives and pressures, periodic accountability reviews, and corrective or disciplinary follow-up
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Quality information supports internal control objectives” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the information used for identified control decisions, documented completeness and accuracy checks, source provenance, timely updates, and handling of missing or unreliable inputs
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Internal control information is communicated internally” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: identified internal recipients, current control responsibilities and policy changes, delivery and acknowledgment records, escalation routes, and follow-up on communication failures
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Control matters are communicated to external parties when required” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: identified external audiences and required control communications, assigned owners, accessible reporting channels, delivery or receipt records, and escalation and resolution of received concerns
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Objectives are specified with sufficient clarity” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: documented organizational and service objectives, measurable success criteria, risk tolerance and management approval, and traceability from objectives into risk assessments and control decisions
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Control deficiencies are evaluated and communicated” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the population of identified control deficiencies, severity and impact assessments, timely escalation to accountable management and oversight bodies, assigned remediation, and verified closure evidence
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Control activities are selected and developed” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: control selection and design decisions linked to identified risks and objectives, accountable risk-owner approvals, the intended operating scope, and evidence that selected activities are implemented
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Technology general controls support objectives” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: technology dependencies supporting objectives, risk-based general control selection over access, processing integrity, acquisition, development and maintenance, and scoped operating records and exceptions
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Policies are deployed through procedures” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: approved policy requirements translated into actionable procedures, assigned ownership, communication and implementation records, timely execution, and corrective follow-up when procedures are not performed
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement; these selected vendor controls provide partial supporting context.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Management establishes structure, authority, and responsibility” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: documented organizational structures and reporting lines, board oversight of authority and responsibility assignments, approved delegations and accountability, communication of role changes, and periodic evaluation and adjustment as objectives change
repairs.source_locator: CCF 127 (BD133); CCF 128 (BD134); CCF 129 (BD135), explicit CC 1.3 references in the SOC 2 2022 column
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. The assessor must verify the full applicable requirement. Evaluate the remaining role-register candidate separately; a role list alone does not establish board oversight or reporting relationships.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Return of assets” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the issued-asset register reconciled to leavers and role changes, return responsibilities and deadlines, notifications, dated custody receipts, inventory updates, and escalation and recovery actions for unreturned assets
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Cisco provides a return-of-property workflow; local timing, worker scope and exceptions must be justified.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Segregation of duties” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the documented incompatible-duty matrix, actual production and administrative entitlements, independent change approvals, attempted self-approval tests, periodic conflict reviews, and approved compensating controls with owners and expiry dates
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Production change separation is one example; the assessor must also identify other incompatible duties in scope.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Intellectual property rights” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the inventory of licensed software and protected material, acquisition and use rights, entitlement counts reconciled to actual use, restrictions on copying or distribution, periodic checks and remediation of unauthorized use
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Software licensing guidance is narrower than all intellectual property rights; non-software material needs separate evidence.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Documented operating procedures” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the inventory of operational procedures, accountable owners, approved current versions accessible to operators, dependencies and failure handling, sampled execution records, and change-driven review of procedures for critical operations
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. SDLC and key-management procedures illustrate operating documentation; they do not establish completeness of all operating procedures.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Contact with special interest groups” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the relevant professional and security groups or advisory channels, designated contacts, active subscriptions or participation records, triage and distribution of received information, and tracked decisions responding to relevant security developments
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Subscription records alone do not demonstrate active use of advice or complete coverage of relevant groups.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Screening” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the role-based screening policy and lawful jurisdictional scope, joiner population reconciled to personnel records, screening completion before relevant access, authorized exceptions, and protections and retention limits for sensitive screening records
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Cisco describes pre-employment screening; local law, proportionality and applicable contractor scope need assessor confirmation.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Terms and conditions of employment” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the approved employment and contractor terms defining security responsibilities, signed acceptance reconciled to the onboarding population, communication before access, updates after role changes, and documented handling of missing or outdated agreements
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Confidentiality agreements are examples within employment terms; they do not establish every security obligation.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Disciplinary process” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the documented response to security policy breaches, communication and acknowledgement of consequences, fair and authorized investigation steps, restricted case records, consistent application to sampled cases, and recorded escalation and closure decisions
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Published consequences and acknowledgements alone do not establish that the disciplinary process operated appropriately.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Responsibilities after termination or change of employment” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the leaver and role-change population, documented continuing security obligations, handover and notice records, approvals for changed duties, dated removal or adjustment of access, and reconciliation of unresolved exceptions against personnel records
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Access revocation and review support only part of continuing responsibilities; confidentiality and other surviving duties need separate evidence.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the inventory of confidentiality agreements and protected information, employee and external-party applicability, approved terms and duration, signed agreements before relevant disclosure, periodic review, and handling of missing signatures or changed obligations
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Vendor examples cover employee and supplier agreements; enforceability and the local information scope require separate review.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “User endpoint devices” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the endpoint inventory reconciled to users and access records, approved configurations, encryption and management enrollment, access restrictions for unmanaged devices, monitoring of deviations, and dated remediation or time-limited exceptions
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Mobile-device enrollment and encryption are partial examples; all applicable endpoint classes and configurations must be assessed.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Protection of information systems during audit testing” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the authorization and risk review for audit tests, agreed scope and timing, least-privilege test access, protection of copied data, monitoring and recovery arrangements, and removal of temporary access and test artifacts
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Cisco cites this target in broad audit and risk controls but does not specify all audit-test protections; these original checks require direct requirement review.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Customers” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the customer-facing allocation of AI responsibilities, communicated intended uses and limits, agreed oversight and incident channels, delivery and acknowledgement records, and sampled follow-up when customer obligations or system behavior change
repairs.source_locator: ISO/IEC 42001 under the SaaS shared responsibility model
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Oracle describes shared provider and customer responsibilities, not a clause-level customer-control crosswalk.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Alignment with other organizational policies” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the AI policy cross-reference to security, privacy, risk, quality and other applicable organizational policies, identified conflicts, accountable resolution and approval, communicated changes, and scheduled or event-triggered checks of continuing alignment
repairs.source_locator: Oracle’s AI management system: Responsible AI embedded in the product lifecycle
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Oracle describes corporate governance integration, not normative requirements for policy alignment.

repairs.objective: Assess the requirement “Processes for responsible design and development of AI systems” within the declared system, period, and population.
repairs.evidence_checks: the documented AI design and development process, assigned lifecycle roles, risk and impact review gates, requirements traceability, verification and validation records, release approvals, and treatment of deviations and subsequent design changes
repairs.source_locator: Oracle’s AI management system: Responsible AI embedded in the product lifecycle
repairs.source_limit: Implementation guidance only; not a published equivalence to the GRC Lake safeguard or complete normative requirement text. Oracle describes lifecycle governance examples, not a published clause crosswalk or complete responsible-development process.
